Do not disclose suspected vulnerabilities or sensitive deployment details in a public issue. Please follow the private reporting instructions in [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/placeauth/spatial-policy-protocol/blob/main/SECURITY.md), including the security@placeauth.org contact address. This issue will be closed without requesting exploit details.
